description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeCsvImportController class, which extends AbstractVueController and manages CSV import functionalities for employee data in the OrangeHRM system. It sets up a Vue component with properties for allowed file types and maximum file size during the pre-render phase.

classes.name: EmployeeCsvImportController
classes.description: A controller class for handling employee CSV import operations, setting up a Vue component with import configurations.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets up the Vue component with properties such as allowed file types and maximum file size before rendering.
